characters.summary: Achilles is the peerless Greek champion and spear fighter, relying on blinding speed, supreme martial skill, and total fearlessness to overwhelm opponents in single combat.

mechanisms: Parrying and dodging blows with exceptional reflexes

weaknesses: Vulnerability in his heel as noted in traditional myth, though downplayed in the gritty realism of the 2004 film adaptation
limitations: Human physiological limits despite superhuman martial prowess

sources.supports: Achilles' role as the Greek champion and spear fighter in the 2004 film Troy.

feats.claim: Killed the Trojan champion Boagrius in single combat swiftly at the start of the film.
Slew the Trojan prince Hector outside the walls of Troy after a prolonged duel.

notableResults.note: Defeated him with a single decisive spear strike.
After a grueling duel, Achilles killed Hector and dragged his body.

unknowns: Exact applicability of the invulnerable heel myth in the grounded 2004 film continuity.

characters.summary: Agamemnon is the ambitious Mycenaean king who commands the Greek alliance, relying on vast armies, political leverage, and subordinate champions rather than personal combat.

mechanisms: Surrounding himself with guards and champions

weaknesses: Overreliance on mercenaries and champions like Achilles whom he alienates
limitations: Relies heavily on his army and champions rather than personal fighting prowess

sources.supports: Agamemnon's role as the Mycenaean king commanding the Greek alliance.

feats.claim: Conquered kingdoms across Greece to consolidate the alliance leading up to the Trojan War.

notableResults.note: Political and diplomatic conflict rather than direct duel.

unknowns: Personal combat capabilities beyond basic aristocratic training.

characters.summary: Agent Smith is a sentient computer program and Matrix enforcer capable of superhuman speed, strength, reality manipulation, and mass duplication of himself.

techniques: Possession / overwriting of human minds inside the Matrix

mechanisms: Resurrection and duplication upon destruction within the Matrix

weaknesses: Tied to the stability of the Matrix simulation
limitations: Powers are restricted to the digital confines of the Matrix

sources.supports: Agent Smith's nature as a Matrix enforcer with superhuman combat and duplication abilities.

feats.claim: Fought Neo to a standstill and subsequently absorbed all inhabitants of the Matrix in his final virus form.

notableResults.note: Defeated when Neo allowed himself to be assimilated, triggering the deletion of the Smith program via the source.

campaignTags.claim: Can fly at high speeds within the Matrix simulation.
Is a sentient computer program acting as an Agent of the Machine world.

unknowns: Exact limits of his assimilation virus outside the Matrix.

characters.summary: Al Powell is a supportive LAPD police sergeant who assists John McClane from outside using police dispatch, radio communication, and small arms fire.

sources.supports: Al Powell's role as a police sergeant supporting McClane from outside in Die Hard.

feats.claim: Shot and killed Karl to save John McClane at the climax of Nakatomi Plaza.

notableResults.note: Ambushed Karl with service revolver shots to end his assault.

unknowns: Combat experience beyond standard metropolitan police work.

weaknesses: Mortal human body vulnerable to supernatural forces and conventional weapons

notableResults.note: Fought off wave attacks during the desert battle.
